rules.coverage_text: Buildings with five or more units.
rules.effective_expression: first day of the second month next following the date of enactment

exemptions.description: Buildings with fewer than five units in which the owner lives.
exemptions.quote: This chapter does not apply to a building with fewer than five units in which the owner lives.

rules.quote: No landlord or agent of a landlord shall charge a prospective tenant an application fee or screening fee that exceeds fifty dollars ($50) for any rental unit in a building with five or more units.
rules.requirement: Landlords and their agents may not charge a prospective tenant an application or screening fee above $50 for a unit in a building with five or more units.
rules.title: Application fee cap
